words.gloss_range: they are made to see or recognize them; locally a passive compelled-recognition clause with a visible plural object suffix
words.root_gloss_range: seeing, perceiving, insight, and evidentiary recognition; the local Form II passive selects imposed recognizability, not ordinary voluntary sight alone

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the attached plural object suffix inside the passive verb

words.prose: {{ar:يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ}} ({{tr:yubaṣṣarūnahum}}) opens as an independent passive clause: a plural group is made to recognize others, and the attached {{ar:ـهُمْ}} ({{tr:-hum}}) keeps the exposed parties inside the verb. The word therefore does not describe calm seeing; Form II passive makes visibility imposed, while the root field lets sight become evidentiary recognition. Variant contrasts matter because simpler active seeing or simple visibility would lose the main reading's imposed display, and the doubled central consonant makes that recognition feel pressed into the word. The matching plural subject and object suffix create reciprocal pressure without fixing a single identity, so 70:10 remains needed for the close-friend boundary behind the pronoun. As the first beat of the ayah, the word launches the movement from public exposure to the singular criminal's private wish and then to the named price. Its sight language also frames the later Day and punishment language: recognition happens under judgment pressure, reversing the prior social non-contact and anticipating lowered eyes near the surah's close (70:44).

words.prose: {{ar:يَوَدُّ}} ({{tr:yawaddu}}) turns the ayah inward after the forced-visibility opening. Its 3ms agreement anticipates {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimu}}), narrowing the plural scene to a single representative desiring subject. The verb governs {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}), so the desired ransom is marked as impossible before the price is even named. The love and affection range of {{ar:و د د}} ({{tr:w-d-d}}) is narrowed here into desperate self-preservation: desire reacts to punishment and is exposed as a wish that cannot secure its object. Across the cited wishing pattern (2:105, 3:69, 4:89), this occurrence specializes frustrated desire as a personal ransom through children. Structurally, the word sits between outer exposure and the later outer price, making hidden desperation visible in the syntax.

The root's cutting and severing background is locally narrowed to moral crime, but beside the proposed offering of {{ar:بَنِيهِ}} ({{tr:banīhi}}) it sharpens the scene: the one marked by severance imagines severing his own lineage. The noun also sits inside a judgment pairing with punishment and the Day, so culpability is exposed under consequence rather than treated as a detached label. Same-surah pressure also matters, because the criminal register that later appears with arrogant rushing (70:36) is here isolated in despair.

words.prose: {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}) is not a neutral if-clause here. After {{ar:يَوَدُّ}} ({{tr:yawaddu}}), it introduces wish-content and keeps irrealis impossibility active, so the ransom action is imagined rather than asserted. Its short clipped shape makes the shift into impossibility abrupt. Its scope reaches over {{ar:يَفْتَدِي}} ({{tr:yaftadī}}) and the price phrase, and the continuing list in 70:12-14 remains part of the same expanding wish-frame. Because no realized conditional answer follows, the grammar leaves the desire suspended: the particle opens a path in thought, not a path in reality.

words.prose: {{ar:يَفْتَدِي}} ({{tr:yaftadī}}) converts the criminal's wish into an imagined transaction. The Form VIII shape and the absence of an explicit direct object make the ransom self-directed: he seeks to ransom himself, not another person. The verb is still under {{ar:لَوْ}} ({{tr:law}}), so it is desired content rather than a possible action. Its visible complements define the exchange: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) marks what he wants escape from, and {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marks the price, with children as the named means. The root borrows captive-release and payment logic, but turns it inward into impossible self-redemption. The uncommon ransom root makes the judgment scene feel economically imagined, but the punishment pairing and later expansion to all people (70:14) keep that economy impossible rather than negotiable. Even the final long vowel carries the verb directly into the source phrase, so the action is heard moving toward what it wants to escape.

It governs {{ar:عَذَابِ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābi}}), so punishment is not a loose topic and not something possessed in part; it is the threat from which separation is imagined. Across the boundary from 70:10, the relational register of not asking shifts into the register of fleeing consequence.

words.prose: {{ar:عَذَابِ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābi}}) is the threat named after {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}): the criminal wants separation from punishment, not merely relief from pain. In the main reading it is a construct head, bound to {{ar:يَوْمِئِذٍ}} ({{tr:yawmiʾidhin}}), so the punishment is specified as the punishment of that Day. The variant with tanwīn and an accusative time expression shows that this construct binding is a real pressure point. The broader {{ar:ع ذ ب}} ({{tr:ʿ-dh-b}}) family includes a sweet-water pole, but local usage selects the dominant torment sense; that polarity sharpens the reversal from palatable sweetness to painful consequence. As the threat half of the exchange, the phrase defines what is escaped before the children are named as the price, reversing rescue patterns in which children or communities would be protected from punishment. The word also turns the surah's announced punishment (70:1) into the personally feared target of ransom, and its heavy guttural opening lets the prior intimacy-and-heat boundary surface as explicit torment.

words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمِئِذٍ}} ({{tr:yawmiʾidhin}}) closes the construct {{ar:عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ}} ({{tr:ʿadhābi yawmiʾidhin}}), specifying which punishment is meant. The {{ar:إِذٍ}} ({{tr:idhin}}) element makes the time deictic: that already activated Day in the surah's eschatological frame, not a newly defined or ordinary day. The broader {{ar:ي و م}} ({{tr:y-w-m}}) field can cover time or epoch, and 70:4 keeps that scale in view, so the local phrase marks a decisive bounded time rather than a simple calendar day. The same root recurs as a surah-local temporal spine (70:4, 70:26, 70:42, 70:43, 70:44), anchoring the ransom wish inside that Day-frame. Variant accusative pressure shows the syntactic choice clearly: in the main reading the Day specifies the punishment; in the variant it would locate the event adverbially. The hamza creates a small catch inside the time word, fitting its function as a deictic threshold. Positioned just before {{ar:بِبَنِيهِ}} ({{tr:bi-banīhi}}), the word finishes defining the threat before the price is named.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi-}}) is the hinge from threat-source to ransom price. After {{ar:مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ}} ({{tr:min ʿadhābi yawmiʾidhin}}) has named what the criminal wants escape from, this preposition scopes forward over {{ar:بَنِيهِ}} ({{tr:banīhi}}), marking the children as means and exchange-price. It blocks a beneficiary reading: the children are not the recipients of ransom but the imagined currency. Because it is written as a proclitic in {{ar:بِبَنِيهِ}} ({{tr:bi-banīhi}}), the grammar of exchange arrives as one bound price unit. Locally, it names children as the first means before the following ayahs widen the inventory.

words.prose: {{ar:بَنِيهِ}} ({{tr:banīhi}}) is the ayah's closing price. The plural noun is possessed by the 3ms suffix, so the proposed ransom is not generic children but his own children, tied back to {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimu}}). The attached {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) governs the word as means and exchange-price, forcing a precious kinship term into commodity grammar. The {{ar:ب ن ي}} ({{tr:b-n-y}}) field can carry building and sonship together; locally the sense is children, while the building image makes them his constructed continuation and future. The child-offering contrast is inverted against the son scene at 37:102: here children are not voluntarily offered in trial or rescued from punishment, but priced for the criminal's own escape. As the final word and first item of the expanding list in 70:12-14, it lands with immediate shock: the criminal's imagined escape begins by pricing his own lineage. The repeated b onset around the bound price phrase tightens the close, so possession, price, lineage, and sound converge on the sacrifice of his own future.

topics.headline: possessive suffix makes the price personal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the criminal offers his own plural children, not a generic offspring category.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links the 3ms suffix to {{ar:ٱلْمُجْرِمُ}} ({{tr:al-mujrimu}}) and marks the suffix as a genitive possessor.

topics.headline: kinship noun is grammatically priced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mismatch: priceless kin are made the means and price of escape.
topics.reason: The noun is governed by the price-marker {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) with the ransom verb, and translation support warns to preserve that role.

topics.headline: building field colors children as constructed continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the children are not only kin but the criminal's built continuation, while the local noun still means children.
topics.reason: The b-n-y and b-n-w dispute is morphological rather than semantically divergent, so the building field colors the kinship noun without replacing the local child sense.

topics.headline: offering and rescue motifs reverse into self-ransom
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that child-offering and punishment-rescue patterns are inverted here: the children are not rescued or voluntarily offered, but priced for the criminal's escape, in contrast with the son scene at 37:102.
topics.reason: The local {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) price role supports the inversion, and the row family supplies the concrete 37:102 contrast.

topics.headline: closing word begins the expanding ransom list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah closes on the first and most intimate price before the list widens through spouse, brother, clan, and all people (70:12-14).
topics.reason: The word is final in the ayah and the CRITICAL rows provide the concrete forward chain through 70:12-14.

topics.headline: repeated b onset tightens the closing price unit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the audible tightening of price-marker and children at the ayah's close.
topics.reason: The sound observation is grounded in the fused surface {{ar:بِبَنِيهِ}} ({{tr:bi-banīhi}}) and the governed price phrase.

topics.headline: owned lineage closes as future-price
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the convergence of possession, lineage, building image, and closing position into the sacrifice of one's own future.
topics.reason: The synthesis row combines claims already supported by possession, price role, root-field coloring, and final position.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive causative sight at word 1 leads directly into the offender's wish, ransom verb, punishment, and sons at words 2, 5, 7, and 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Compelled sight brings recognized persons into view; the offender's wish immediately recodes his own filiation as the substitute-price by which punishment might be displaced. Visibility initiates a one-way sacrificial exchange.

activation_trace.role: Enabled eye-sight supplies the compelled recognition that starts the exchange calculus.
Wishing for an outcome supplies the counterfactual desire to escape.
Guilt and offense identify the desiring subject as liable rather than as a neutral observer.
A ransom or substitute supplies the attempted transfer of danger from self to another.
Torment and punitive pain supply the pressure the exchange is meant to remove.
Filiation supplies actual sons as the offender's closest derived belonging and proposed price.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports that people see acquaintances and that an offender wants rescue.
changed_reading.after: Being made to see kin initiates a desperate substitution calculus in which the offender treats his own descendants as ransom-bearing extensions of himself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative passive of ب ص ر at word 1 stands beside the liability noun from ج ر م at word 3 and the offender's exposed wish at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: Forced sight can operate inwardly as well as optically: the one who has incurred guilt is made to apprehend his condition, and the wish to purchase escape discloses the moral interior that ordinary seeing could leave hidden.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight and self-witness turn caused seeing into compelled moral apprehension.
Earning or causing liability supplies the offender's acquired relation to the crisis.
The offense branch fixes that acquired burden as culpability.
The wish gives the newly exposed interior a specific impossible direction.
Ransom renders the inward recognition legible as an attempted displacement of liability.

changed_reading.before: The opening verb merely makes other people visually identifiable.
changed_reading.after: The opening can also stage coerced self-witness: recognition of others exposes the offender's own culpability through the sacrifice he immediately desires.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins the cutting and liability possibilities of ج ر م, the substitution of ف د ي, and the filiation and construction images of ب ن ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: Sons remain literal descendants, but the construction branches let them also register as continuations and settled supports of the offender's house. He imagines cutting those supports away and putting them up in his place, preserving the isolated self by dismantling what extends it.

activation_trace.role: Cutting off and harvesting supplies the severing action in the proposed exchange.
Substitution gives the severed element its intended function as a protective price.
Building by joined parts supplies the household-structure analogy.
Filiation keeps the construction analogy anchored in the verse's actual sons.
Ribs and house-posts supply the image of descendants as load-bearing continuations of a life.

changed_reading.before: Offering sons is an isolated act of cruelty toward loved kin.
changed_reading.after: The offer is also self-disassembly: the offender would cut away the lineage supports that compose and continue his social self in order to preserve its bare center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired seeing verbs assign the same coming event opposite scales: human sight casts it far away, while divine sight locates it near. The focus passive then reads as correction by event: what was mis-seen as distant becomes present, and recognition of one's human ties can no longer be deferred.

activation_trace.role: Caused eye-sight supplies the later compulsory recognition.
Eye-sight and insight supply the human act of estimating the event.
Distance from nearness supplies the human horizon of postponement.
The same sight branch supplies the counter-estimate rather than a different faculty.
Temporal nearness and completion collapse the delay presumed by the human view.

structural_cues: 70:6 and 70:7 repeat the seeing construction across opposed distance predicates before the passive causative sight of 70:11.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed estimates and later caused seeing; I infer a movement from active miscalibration to compelled presence. A live alternative is that the distance contrast dates the event without governing recognition of persons.

changed_reading.before: The focus opens an otherwise neutral spectacle of mutual recognition.
changed_reading.after: The spectacle is a forced recalibration: persons who treated the day as remote are made to see their ties inside the nearness they had misjudged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The overhead expanse becomes molten matter and hard elevations become soft wool. Against that material unmaking, the focus construction imagery is sharpened: descendants are the offender's settled lineage supports, yet he tries to render even them detachable and exchangeable when no apparently stable support remains stable.

activation_trace.role: House-posts and ribs supply the focus image of descendants as settled supports.
Filiation anchors those supports in actual sons rather than free material metaphor.
Ransom turns a support into proposed exchange matter.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the largest apparent covering structure.
Molten substances and residues supply the sky's loss of stable form.
A hard elevated mass supplies the paradigm of material solidity.
Soft dyed wool supplies that solidity's loosened, manipulable state.

structural_cues: The paired similes of 70:8-9 transform sky and mountains immediately before the sequence turns to failed relations and kin-ransom.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two material transformations and focus construction branches; I supply the analogy from cosmic support-loss to social support-liquidation. The live alternative is that the similes establish spectacle only and do not organize the kinship sequence.

changed_reading.before: The sons are only beloved persons selected as an extreme price.
changed_reading.after: They also register as the first load-bearing lineage support made exchangeable in a world where apparently permanent structures have lost their form.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding line removes request and concern between intimates, while the focus restores visual access to them. Sight therefore does not repair relation: the visible intimate becomes material for the singular offender's own rescue wish instead of an interlocutor whose condition is asked about.

activation_trace.role: Enabled eye-sight makes the other present without guaranteeing care.
Questioning and requesting supply the relational act that is explicitly absent.
Near kinship and intimacy identify the very relation from which inquiry collapses.
The singular wish replaces mutual inquiry with a self-directed counterfactual.
Ransom converts visible relation into a one-way protective substitution.
Filiation makes the failure of solicitude maximally intimate.

structural_cues: 70:10 negates asking between two intimates; 70:11 opens with a passive plural and object pronoun before narrowing to one offender's wish.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent inquiry, intimate relation, caused sight, and ransom; I infer that sight without asking becomes instrumentalization. A live alternative is that terror merely blocks speech and the ransom wish is a separate reaction.

changed_reading.before: Being shown one another overcomes separation and permits recognition.
changed_reading.after: Recognition without solicitude intensifies the rupture: the other is fully visible yet approached only as a possible shield for the self.

context_deltas.mechanism: The proposed price expands from sons through spouse, brother, protective clan, and everyone on earth, while the desired result remains the offender's separated escape. The focus is thus the first ring of a widening liquidation of every relation around an isolated self.

activation_trace.role: Filiation supplies the first and closest stated ring of the ransom inventory.
Ransom gives every subsequently listed relation the same proposed substitution function.
Companionship and abiding association extend the price into the household bond.
Brotherhood and kinship add a lateral blood relation to the offer.
The man's clan expands the price from household persons to the kin-group.
Gathering shelter identifies that clan as the protection the offender would sacrifice.
Wholeness without remainder pushes the inventory to total inclusion.
Escape by separation supplies the unchanged goal at the end of the expanding offer.

structural_cues: The coordinated list in 70:12-14 continues the focus's ransom price and delays the rescue verb until after universal inclusion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered list, sheltering clan, totality, and escape; I infer concentric social distance and liquidation around the self. A live alternative is that the order marks rhetorical accumulation without a strict proximity ranking.

changed_reading.before: The sons are one shocking ransom option.
changed_reading.after: The sons open a systematic outward expansion in which household, kin-group, shelter, and finally the whole human field are liquidated for one person's separated survival.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gathering and enclosing value, withholding good, and the counter-image of a fixed claim for requester and deprived create a moral economy around the focus. Under punishment, possessiveness reverses into liquidation, but still perversely: the offender would spend descendants for himself after the human type had closed assets against legitimate outward claims.

activation_trace.role: Earning and causing liability connect acquisition to the offender's incurred burden.
Ransom supplies the emergency expenditure that reverses prior enclosure.
Filiation keeps the liquidated value anchored in persons, not ordinary property.
Joining scattered things into a collection supplies the acquisitive accumulation.
Putting a thing into a container supplies enclosure and retention after gathering.
Withholding the hand from giving supplies the closed direction of value.
Possessing and increasing wealth identifies the domain in which a different transfer is required.
A fixed obligatory entitlement supplies the rightful outward claim on accumulated value.
The requester supplies one legitimate recipient whom giving should answer.
Deprivation and missing the desired good supply the other legitimate recipient's need.

structural_cues: 70:18 compresses gathering and storing into one line; 70:21 names withholding; 70:24-25 reverse direction by locating an established claim within wealth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accumulation, enclosure, withholding, wealth, and rightful recipients; I infer that the focus ransom is a crisis reversal of the same possessive economy. A live alternative is that the focus offender and the later generic human portrait are related examples rather than one continuous type.

changed_reading.before: The offender's offer is desperate generosity at the last possible moment.
changed_reading.after: It is possessiveness under reversal: value finally flows outward only to buy the self, and even persons are treated as reserves while rightful claims had defined a non-self-serving economy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Continuance, enacted verification of the day of accounting, fear-inflected care, guarded practice, and standing witness form an anticipatory mode of perception. The focus sight is the inverse condition: perception arrives compulsorily and too late, revealing both liability and the wish to transfer it.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight and self-witness supply the focus's belated compelled apprehension.
Incurred liability supplies what late apprehension cannot undo.
Stillness and continuance supply sustained practice rather than crisis perception.
Making a promise true in deed supplies enacted verification of the coming day.
Accounting and recompense identify what is kept present before its arrival.
Care mixed with fear supplies an affective vigilance toward punishment.
Maintaining and adhering to an obligation supply guarded continuity.
Presence with direct witnessing supplies a practiced counterpart to forced sight.

structural_cues: The exception block is bracketed by repeated prayer language and places the day, punishment, entrusted obligations, and testimony inside recurring practices.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies durable practice, verification, accounting, fear, custody, and witness; I infer that these keep realities perceptually present before compulsory sight. A live alternative is that the middle block is ethical contrast without an epistemic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The offender simply lacked information until the day exposed it.
changed_reading.after: His sight is late rather than merely absent: the surah contrasts crisis-forced apprehension with practices that continually witness obligations, judgment, and vulnerability in advance.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sustained forward gaze toward the addressee, the focus's compelled sight, and the final humbled eyes form a visual reversal. Sight moves from presumptive orientation, through unavoidable recognition, to the bodily site overrun by humiliation; being made to see is exposure, not visual mastery.

activation_trace.role: Directing and sustaining the gaze supplies the earlier posture of confident visual approach.
Caused eye-sight supplies the compulsory midpoint of the reversal.
Lowering and submission turn the eyes from forward assertion into abjection.
The eye faculty explicitly relocates the focus's sight motif onto their own humbled gaze.
Overwhelming coverage makes humiliation something that masters and envelops them.
Brokenness under coercion supplies the terminal condition of the gaze.

structural_cues: The late plural eye noun repeats the focus root and attaches a lowered posture plus an engulfing predicate to the same people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sustained gaze, caused sight, humbled eyes, engulfing, and brokenness; I infer a visual arc from presumption to exposure to subjection. A live alternative is that the postures describe separate scenes without a continuous gaze mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Being made to see grants the offenders fuller visual access to others.
changed_reading.after: The access is punitive exposure within a gaze reversal: those who looked forward presumptively are forced to recognize and end with their own eyes mastered by humiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The offender imagines that he can manage substitution by placing sons where his punished self stands. The later sequence assigns effective replacement elsewhere: divine capacity can put others in their place, cannot be outstripped, and leaves them to meet the appointed event. Human ransom is exposed as counterfeit control inside a replacement order the offender does not govern.

activation_trace.role: Ransom and substitution supply the offender's attempted reassignment of exposure.
Filiation identifies the persons he presumes to place in his stead.
Effective capacity that reaches action and mastery supplies the actual power behind replacement.
One thing standing in another's place supplies an explicit counter-substitution.
Eluding a pursuer supplies the escape possibility that is denied.
What a person encounters, good or bad, supplies unavoidable arrival at the event.
An appointment fixed by time or place supplies the event's governed terminus.

structural_cues: 70:40-42 moves through capacity, replacement, inability to get ahead, and eventual encounter with the appointed day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine capacity and replacement, denied evasion, and appointed encounter; I map that sequence as a reversal of the focus ransom attempt. A live alternative is that replacing a people concerns succession only and does not answer the focus's exchange logic.

changed_reading.before: The ransom fails because the offered price is insufficient.
changed_reading.after: The deeper failure is agency: the offender performs an imagined substitution inside a scene where effective replacement belongs to a power he cannot outrun and whose appointment he must meet.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the blood-trace and blood-money edge of ب ص ر rather than its ordinary sight branch. It remains anchored by the focus's compelled seeing, ransom, offense, and actual filiation, which together can image sons as a visible blood-price. Downstream prose should present this only as a branch-generated material analogy, never as the lexical translation of the opening verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus itself places ب ص ر at word 1 beside offense, ransom, and sons at words 3, 5, and 9.

activation_trace.role: A visible blood trace with extensions to blood-revenge or blood-money supplies the outlier's material price image.
Guilt and offense supply the liability around which a blood-price image can gather.
Ransom supplies the explicit compensatory exchange.
Filiation supplies the actual blood relation that keeps the analogy attached to sons.

changed_reading.before: The visible persons merely furnish possible ransom victims.
changed_reading.after: At the branch-image level, compelled visibility can make the offender's own bloodline appear as the compensatory blood-price he wishes to tender.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from bodily mass and built constitution to literal sons, then reads the stripping of extremities as an analogy for lineage loss. It remains anchored by the focus's body, constitution, punishment, and filiation branches plus the context's removal imagery. Downstream prose should qualify it as an extended-body model, not claim that sons grammatically denote organs or that 70:16 directly glosses 70:11.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The offender, punishment, and sons permit a contained analogy between the culpable body and the descendants who constitute its extension.

activation_trace.role: Bodily frame and mass supply the central self whose boundaries the analogy extends.
Built constitution supplies the model of a self composed through related parts.
Filiation anchors the extended parts in actual descendants.
Punitive pain supplies the force against which bodily and lineage integrity fail.
Uprooting a thing from its fixed place supplies forcible disassembly.
Extremities and non-vital body parts supply the image of an extended body stripped from its center.

changed_reading.before: The offender tries to preserve his body by giving unrelated external victims.
changed_reading.after: The sons can be carried as an extended body: offering them anticipates the punitive stripping of the very continuations and supports through which the self exceeds its physical center.

strongest_changes: Compelled sight became a correction of temporal and moral misperception rather than neutral visual disclosure.
The sons became the first ring in a widening liquidation of every protective relation around an isolated self.
The ransom attempt became a possessive economy in reverse, opposed both to rightful outward claims and to sustained anticipatory witness.
Human substitution was exposed as counterfeit agency under divine replacement, unavoidable encounter, and a final reversal of the gaze.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots supported two unusually productive crossings: ب ن ي joined literal filiation to built supports, and ب ص ر joined forced recognition to self-witness and, at the contained edge, a visible blood-price. Context then converted these from isolated word-images into temporal, social, economic, material, and visual mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise antecedent and reciprocity of the object pronoun in the opening passive remain structurally open.
The construction, cosmic-collapse, blood-price, and extended-body readings remain analogical activations rather than lexical replacements.
The degree to which the later generic human portrait identifies the focus offender, rather than merely contrasting with him, remains uncertain.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Forced visibility enables a morally inverted substitution.** *Yuftadī* anchors **ف د ي, B001, “putting something up as ransom or substitute.”** The passive *yubaṣṣarūnahum* first supplies sight of the very people later enumerated as payment (70:11–14). I infer the directional arrow: being made to see possible substitutes triggers the wish to transfer exposure from self to kin. The ayah reads as vision corrupted into valuation, not as recognition leading to care.

2. **Ransom becomes attempted avoidance.** **ف د ي, B003, “avoiding something by keeping away,”** is activated by the sequence of ever-wider substitutes and by 70:2’s denial of a warding force. I infer that the imagined exchange is less an economy accepted by judgment than a desperate shielding maneuver. Thus *law yaftadī* exposes the criminal’s desire to make another body the barrier that the ayah has already denied.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The disciplined witness who stands by testimony in 70:33 unexpectedly corrected the forced sight here. Later context distinguished seeing that monetizes persons from seeing that sustains another’s claim.

baseline.text: Birbirlerine gösterilirler. Suçlu, o günün azabından kendini oğullarıyla kurtarmayı ister.

findings.text: Zorla gösterilme, önceki gönüllü uzaklık yargısını bozar; kişi artık hem gerçeği hem de birbirini görmeyi denetleyemez.
Görme, ilgiyi doğurmak yerine görülen kişileri olası bedeller olarak değerlendirmeye dönüşür; tanıma, insanı hesap kalemine çevirir.
Çocuklara duyulan sevgi, onları değerli kıldığı için fidye olarak kullanılabilir hale gelir; bağlılık kendi karşıtına, sevilenin yerine verilmesine çevrilir.
Fidye tasarısı kabul edilecek bir alışverişten çok, başka bir bedeni daha önce yokluğu bildirilen savunma engeli yapma girişimidir.
Kendisini cezadan çekip çıkarma isteği, kısa süre sonra çekip çıkarma işleminin kendi bedenine yönelmesiyle tersine çevrilir.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Heat converts stable forms into melt, fiber, cooked flesh, and stripped residue.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mountain textile losing its seams
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A massive, woven structure softens into dyed fiber and separates at its joints and decorative spacers.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Mountain solidity is reconstructed as textile engineering: thick mass, good weave, seam, joint, spacer, cord, and dyed wool. The collapse begins as soft fracture without clean separation, then proceeds by the failure of the joins that held the monumental fabric together.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Thermal Unmaking of Sky, Mountain, and Body

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Restraint, Enclosure, and the Loss of an Exit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Holding can be ethical self-command, protective enclosure, coercive confinement, or pathological pressure.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same holding operation moves from beautiful patience to stopper, wall, armor, shackle, sealed wound, and crookedly healed bone.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Coercive enclosure
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A captive is fixed inside walls, armor, sheath, vessel, and shackle with no outlet.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: detention for execution or compelled oath `quranic:root_000840:B002/m01`; ordeal with no opening `quranic:root_000840:B006/m01`; hand-to-neck shackle `quranic:root_000259:B008/m01`; enclosing vessel `quranic:root_001664:B002/m01`; covering defense `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; armor or shield `quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`; sword sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`; short defensive wall `quranic:root_001159:B007/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene assembles progressively tighter boundaries: wall, armor, sheath, vessel, then shackle. What begins as protection changes role under judgment; every enclosure becomes part of confinement.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relations that ordinarily shelter, love, and remain near are recoded as substitutable assets offered for one person's release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The family list becomes at once a household map, a surety system, a prisoner exchange, and a total inventory.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The sheltering intimate network
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Affection and proximity bind child, spouse, sibling, clan, companion, and refuge into one protective network.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: affectionate close relative `quranic:root_000001:B011/m01`; sonship and descent `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; companionship and continual presence `quranic:root_000844:B001/m01`; preservation through companionship `quranic:root_000844:B002/m01`; grown son becoming companion `quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`; sibling kinship `quranic:root_000020:B001/m01`; tether or inviolable bond `quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`; near clan segment `quranic:root_001159:B009/m01`; sheltering convergence `quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`; merciful concern `quranic:root_000070:B002/m01`; blood-nearness `quranic:root_001212:B003/m01`; affection `quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`; loving alliance `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The list is a functioning social architecture: love supplies motive, kinship supplies nearness, companionship supplies duration, the tether supplies obligation, clan supplies collective backing, and refuge supplies place. Ransom violates every role at once.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Relations that ordinarily shelter, love, and remain near are recoded as substitutable assets offered for one person's release.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Substitution, surety, and prisoner exchange
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A liable person tries to place another life, property, or guarantor between himself and the penalty.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sacrificial substitute `quranic:root_001136:B001/m01`; prisoner exchange `quranic:root_001136:B002/m01`; using another as protective ransom `quranic:root_001136:B003/m01`; diverting harm `quranic:root_000480:B001/m01`; ownership and disposal `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; effective capacity `quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`; surety and personal guarantee `quranic:root_000840:B003/m01`; undertaking care for another `quranic:root_001332:B003/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Ransom is a juridical mechanism rather than a vague wish: it requires a substitute, transferable control, capacity to tender it, and a surety accepted by the other side. “No repeller” means this proposed exchange has no receiving institution and no valid guarantor.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Visibility, Bodily Evidence, and Inscribed Judgment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What was estimated, hidden, or relationally ignored is made perceptible through sight, marks, seams, blood, and text.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Visual disclosure extends into mirror, banner, blood trace, stitched edge, textual division, and signature.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Forced mutual visibility
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Observers face one another and are made to see what their prior estimate displaced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sensory and inward sight `quranic:root_000531:B001/m01`; considered perception `quranic:root_000531:B002/m01`; mutual facing within sight `quranic:root_000531:B004/m01`; mirror and visible aspect `quranic:root_000531:B006/m01`; making another see `quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`; ocular vision `quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`; inward discernment `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; waiting for what is expected `quranic:root_001675:B012/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Seeing progresses from perception, to estimate, to mutual facing, to compelled display. The mirror motif removes the safety of a one-sided gaze: the criminal sees the relatives and, in the same scene, becomes visible to them.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Visibility, Bodily Evidence, and Inscribed Judgment

A standard points, a tongue distinguishes, divisions organize, detail discloses components, and a signature closes the record. The relatives listed in discrete sequence read like the articulated sections of the criminal's liability.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Bodily fluid lands, leaves a visible trace, and records the force that produced it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Hoard as Vessel, Fist, and Shackle
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Accumulation compresses dispersed value into a controlled interior, but the same enclosing operation converts possession into restraint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The hoard takes the forms of fist, full vessel, rope, stopper, healed fracture, and hand-to-neck iron.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stored value hardens into restraint
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The enclosing equipment of storage changes function and binds its owner.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hand-to-neck iron `quranic:root_000259:B008/m01`; crookedly healed bone `quranic:root_001664:B003/m01`; no alternative exit `quranic:root_001664:B006/m01`; vessel or well stopper `quranic:root_000840:B018/m01`; enclosing sword sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`; heavy gathered rope `quranic:root_000260:B002/m01`; stitched enclosure `quranic:root_000121:B006/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rope, seam, sheath, stopper, and vessel are ordinary holding technologies. Their culmination in a shackle reveals the pressure within the hoard: the apparatus used to retain wealth becomes the apparatus that retains the person.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Hoard as Vessel, Fist, and Shackle
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Accumulation compresses dispersed value into a controlled interior, but the same enclosing operation converts possession into restraint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The hoard takes the forms of fist, full vessel, rope, stopper, healed fracture, and hand-to-neck iron.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wealth, collusion, and obsessive possession
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Property is acquired, guarded by alliance, and pursued until engagement with it becomes compulsive.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: enduring large estate `quranic:root_000458:B016/m01`; ownership and disposal `quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`; collusive assembly around an affair `quranic:root_000259:B013/m01`; obsessive immersion in a matter `quranic:root_000480:B011/m01`; gain and acquisition `quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`; gathered food-stock or marketable dates `quranic:root_001136:B004/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The hoard is sustained socially as well as materially: acquisition feeds an estate, allies coordinate around it, and the possessor becomes engrossed in its defense. That network explains why accumulation can compete with every prior kinship claim.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Gestation, Weaning, and the Severed Offspring Bond
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Life is joined through mating and gestation, then differentiated through birth, weaning, and maturation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The family list expands into animal breeding, visible pregnancy, uterine tissue, milk-before-birth, weaning, and the adult child becoming a companion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Separation by weaning and maturation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The young is separated from the mother, then grows until it can stand beside the parent as a companion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: young camel separated from mother and milk `quranic:root_001159:B003/m01`; young livestock separated until compliant `quranic:root_001684:B015/m01`; son maturing into companion `quranic:root_000844:B005/m01`; offspring and descent `quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`; small offshoots named as daughters or sons `quranic:root_000156:B008/m01`; food building flesh `quranic:root_000156:B010/m01`; formed bodily structure `quranic:root_000156:B002/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Separation is normally developmental: the young leaves milk, grows flesh and structure, and becomes a companion. Ransom deforms that process by treating mature relational independence as permission to sever obligation.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Cultivation, Cutting, and the Hoarded Harvest
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Rain and soil produce covered growth that is cut, sorted, and gathered into post-harvest stock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The hoard resembles a crop economy whose seed-covering, irrigation, palm propagation, cutting, gleaning, drying, and piling have been detached from redistribution.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cutting, gleaning, and piling
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Mature growth is cut, residual dates are gleaned, palm stock is propagated, and food is amassed into an unmeasured pile.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: cutting fruit and shearing `quranic:root_000239:B001/m01`; dates left after harvest `quranic:root_000239:B002/m01`; seed-grown date palms of mixed kind `quranic:root_000259:B011/m01`; transplanted palm shoot `quranic:root_001159:B016/m01`; piled food sold without measure `quranic:root_000840:B011/m01`; gathered dates or grain `quranic:root_001136:B004/m01`; taking the whole stock `quranic:root_000751:B009/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Harvest separates crop from plant, then recovers leftovers and gathers them into a pile. The final “taking the whole stock” motif turns gleaning's residual economy into total appropriation, aligning the harvest scene tightly with the hoarder.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Animated Body, Suppurating Wound, and Death-Pull
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: The living body is an assembled form sustained by breath, then marked by heat and injury before animation is withdrawn.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Breath, lung, bodily frame, fever, sweat, saddle sore, pus, and death-throe form a complete deterioration sequence.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Breath within an assembled frame
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Life inhabits a structured body whose lungs, torso, and extremities remain perceptible.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: life-giving spirit `quranic:root_000609:B001/m01`; lung and its ailments `quranic:root_000531:B009/m01`; bodily mass `quranic:root_000239:B007/m01`; composed bodily structure `quranic:root_000156:B002/m01`; extremities and scalp `quranic:root_000830:B002/m01`; rump flesh `quranic:root_000076:B015/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `70:4` الرُّوح (`ر و ح`); `70:6-7` يَرَوْن/نَرَى (`ر ء ي`); `70:11` الْمُجْرِم، بَنِيه (`ج ر م`, `ب ن ي`); `70:16` الشَّوَى (`ش و ي`); surface anchor unavailable for `ء ل ي` in `70:4`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The body appears as a composed frame animated by spirit and breathing through lung. Naming the extremities against that whole makes stripping a disassembly of a living architecture, not a generic image of pain.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Heat, sweat, sore, and pus
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Heat produces sweat and fever; repeated bearing opens sores that retain corrupt fluid.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sweat under heat `quranic:root_000001:B004/m01`; bodily fever `quranic:root_000001:B005/m01`; saddle lesion `quranic:root_000458:B017/m01`; riding abrasion `quranic:root_001675:B010/m01`; suppurating ulcer `quranic:root_000025:B011/m01`; pus-filled wound `quranic:root_001664:B004/m01`; blood trace `quranic:root_000121:B004/m01`.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Sovereign Capacity, Crime, and Unaccepted Surety
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A fixed penalty issues from effective dominion, distinguishes liability, and cannot be neutralized by private ownership or guarantee.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Divine title, royal rule, calibrated design, adjudication, criminal gain, surety, and retribution form one legal order.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Adjudication and criminal liability
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An offense is identified, judgment separates truth from false claim, and retribution reaches completion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: decisive judgment `quranic:root_001159:B002/m01`; offense and criminality `quranic:root_000239:B004/m01`; gain that incurs responsibility `quranic:root_000239:B003/m01`; fixed obligation `quranic:root_001675:B001/m01`; severe judicial event `quranic:root_001675:B002/m01`; retributive equivalence `quranic:root_000840:B012/m01`; decreed outcome `quranic:root_000001:B010/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Crime is linked to acquisition, then passed through decisive separation and equivalent requital. The falling event is thus a judgment that has moved from liability to execution, not an unclassified catastrophe.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 70:1-18] Covering, Refuge, and Exposure to the Sky
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Covering can shelter, conceal, or dignify, but judgment removes the interval between a body and the exposed heavens.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Canopy, garment, fruit sheath, armor, tent, mountain pass, and high refuge all test distinct ways of being covered.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Layered protective covers
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body or valuable object is wrapped by textile, armor, sheath, canopy, and enclosing wall.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: material covering `quranic:root_001307:B001/m01`; darkness or broad water as cover `quranic:root_001307:B002/m01`; fruit sheath `quranic:root_001307:B010/m01`; covered mountain pass `quranic:root_001307:B013/m01`; covering crown `quranic:root_001307:B015/m01`; overhead canopy `quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`; leather tent or spread `quranic:root_000156:B004/m01`; armor `quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`; blade sheath `quranic:root_001212:B010/m01`.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Protection is built in layers from sheath and armor to tent, wall, mountain pass, and sky. The crown adds status to shelter, showing that covering guards both body and rank before the molten canopy invalidates both.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A curved body adheres to its string, the string is drawn, and stored tension is aimed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Stored force is drawn into a cord or weapon, released in flight, and registered as penetration, sound, and bodily extraction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Flight, strike, and penetration
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sharpened projectile travels, strikes audibly, and either penetrates, overshoots, or leaves a bodily mark.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: sharpened iron or blade `quranic:root_001675:B009/m01`; audible blow `quranic:root_001675:B004/m01`; battlefield strike `quranic:root_001675:B005/m01`; arrow passing beyond its target `quranic:root_000458:B018/m01`; losing cast or failed arrow `quranic:root_000458:B019/m01`; blood trace `quranic:root_000121:B004/m01`; pulling an object from its seat `quranic:root_001489:B001/m01`.

pericope.label: The ascending ways and approaching judgment

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gözle görmeyi, görme duyusunu, bakan organı, kör olmayan kişiyi, dikkatle bakışı ve yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesini birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dalın ana kimliği bedensel görme alanıdır; kalp bilgisi veya delil anlamları bu dala taşınmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Duyusal göz ve görme eylemiyle sınırlıdır; iç kavrayış ve kan, silah, taş ya da dikiş anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak görme duyusunu temel alır, fakat dikkatle bakma ve yavrunun göz açması gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrı bağlı uzantılar olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Gözle görme alanı: görme duyusu, bakan göz organı, bir şeyi gözle görmek ve gözün görmeye açılması. Dikkatle dikilerek bakma veya yavrunun gözünün açılması gibi kullanımlar bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

facets.statement: Görme duyusu, bakan göz organı ve bir şeyi gözle görme eylemi çekirdeği oluşturur.
Görme yetisine sahip kişi kör olanın karşıtı olarak adlandırılır.
Dikkatle ve keskin biçimde bakma, görme çekirdeğine bağlı kalıplaşmış bir kullanımdır.
Yavrunun gözünün açılıp görmeye hazır hale gelmesi de görme alanına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak malzemesi bu dalı bedensel görmeye bağlar: göz organı, görme duyusu, gözle görme eylemi ve görme yetisi olan kişi. Aynı toplu iddia ayrıca yoğun bakış kalıbını ve yavrunun gözünün açılmasını çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Göz duyusu, göz organı ve gözle görme eylemini birlikte karşılayan en kısa doğal ifadedir.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel görme çekirdeğini, gözle algılama eylemini ve görme yetisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz gözün gücü veya duyusu hakkında olduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Duyu ve yeti tarafını korur.
error_profile.loses: Görme eylemini, göz organını ve kalıplaşmış bakış kullanımlarını dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yoğun ve dikilerek bakma kalıbında kullanılmalıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Keskin bakış özel kullanımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel görme duyusu ve göz organı anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: dikkatle dikilerek bakış; belirgin ve sert durum

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu referans organ adına daha yakındır; bu dal organla birlikte duyuyu, eylemi ve kimi bağlı kullanımları da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal görmeyi daha genel algı ve kimi iç görme kullanımlarıyla birlikte ele alır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın sınırı bedensel göz alanına daha sıkıdır; komşu görme fiilini daha geniş algı alanına taşıyabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yayımlanan ayrımlar en olası karışıklıkları verir: aynı kökün iç kavrayış dalı, göz organı ve genel görme-algılama alanı. Diğer adaylar yalnızca uzak senaryo veya örnek benzerliği sağladığı için sınırı daha fazla keskinleştirmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البصر حاسة العين والجارحة الناظرة وفعل الرؤية والنظر بتحديق وفتح العين أو جعلها تبصر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه علم القلب والبصيرة الدينية ولا الحجة والعبرة ولا الدم ولا السلاح ولا الحجارة ولا الخياطة والغلظ.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أبصرته إذا رأيته (maqayis)؛ البصر العين (ayn;tahdhib)؛ البصر حاسة الرؤية وأبصرت الشيء رأيته والبصير خلاف الضرير (sihah)؛ والبصر معروف أبصر يبصر إبصارا فهو مبصر وبصير (jamhara)؛ الجارحة الناظرة والباصرة (mufradat)؛ رأيته لمحا باصرا أي نظرا بتحديق شديد (maqayis;sihah;tahdhib;mufradat)؛ بصر الجرو تبصيرا فتح عينه (ayn;tahdhib;mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı kalpteki kavrayış, bilgi, dinî doğrulanma, delil, ibret ve kişinin kendi aleyhine tanıklığı gibi bedensel olmayan anlama alanına yerleştirir. Göz duyusu burada çekirdek değildir; görme dili bilgi ve kalp idraki için kullanılır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İç bilgi, delil ve kavrayış alanıdır; çıplak gözle görme, kan, silah, taş ve dikiş anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilgi ve iç kavrayış kullanımlarını korur, din veya iş hakkında aydınlanma gibi kalıba bağlı kullanımları ayrıca sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Kalbin veya zihnin bir şeyi bilip kavraması, doğruluğa ermesi ve bunun delil, ibret ya da açıklayıcı kanıt olarak görünmesi. Din veya belirli bir iş konusunda bilinçli hale gelme bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.
Bu iç kavrayış delil, kanıt, ibret ve açıklayıcı bildirim anlamlarına uzanır.
Bir işte veya dinde bilinçli, kavrayış sahibi ve sağlam kanaatli olma özel bir kullanımdır.
Düşünüp tanıma ve kendini açık biçimde bilme bu bilgi alanına bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak iddiası dalı bilgi, kalbin nüfuzu, doğrulanmış kavrayış ve delil alanında birleştirir. Aynı malzeme dinî sağlam görüş, ibret ve açıklayıcı kanıt kullanımlarını da bu çekirdeğe bağlı gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kalpte veya zihinde gerçekleşen bilgi, doğrulanma ve delil anlamlarını doğal biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bedensel olmayan kavrama, bilgi ve sağlam anlayış çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz kanıt, ibret veya açıklayıcı belge işlevi gördüğünde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kanıt ve açıklama uzantısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kalpteki bilme ve dinî kavrayış boyutlarını dışarıda bırakır.

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi, doğrulanma ve özel konuda kavrayış sahibi olmayı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: işinde veya dininde kavrayış sahibi olmak

error_profile.preserves: Algılama fikrine uzak bir bağ kurabilir.
error_profile.loses: Kalpteki bilgi, delil ve doğrulanmış kavrayışı kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda vurgu anlayışın keskinliği ve hızı üzerindedir; bu dalda bilgiye dayanan iç açıklık ve delil boyutu belirgindir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bilip doğrulamayı anlatır; komşu ise aklın sınırlayıcı ve koruyucu işlevini öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Öncelik aynı kökün gözle görme dalına ve yakın zihinsel alan adaylarına verildi. Diğer adaylar bilgi, şüphe veya araştırma alanında daha uzak kaldığı için ayrı yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه العلم بالشيء ونفاذ القلب والمعرفة والتحقق والاستبصار في الدين والحجة والعبرة وشهادة الإنسان على نفسه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مجرد حاسة العين ولا اللمعان الحسي ولا الدم ولا السلاح ولا الحجارة ولا الخياطة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أحدهما العلم بالشيء وبصرت بالشيء إذا صرت به بصيرا عالما والبصيرة البرهان (maqayis)؛ البصر نفاذ في القلب والبصيرة اسم لما اعتقد في القلب من الدين وحقيق الأمر واستبصر في أمره ودينه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ حسن البصيرة إذا كان مستبصرا في دينه (jamhara)؛ البصر العلم وبصرت بالشيء علمته والتبصر التأمل والتعرف والبصيرة الحجة والاستبصار في الشيء (sihah)؛ لقوة القلب المدركة بصيرة وبصر وعلى معرفة وتحقق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yalnızca ışıklı oluşa indirmez; aydınlatan, açık kılan, kendisiyle görülen veya insanları görür hale getiren işlevleri birlikte verir. Bu yüzden dal kabul edilebilir, fakat tanım hem aydınlık hem de açıklayıcı işlevi birlikte taşımalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Görmeyi veya anlamayı mümkün kılan açıklıkla sınırlıdır; göz organı ya da yalın iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak biçimin aydınlatıcı ve açıklayıcı işlevini verir; kalıba bağlı ayrı bir anlam genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin aydınlık, açık veya açıklayıcı olup görmeyi ya da anlamayı mümkün kılması. Bu alan, işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesiyle tanımlanır.

facets.statement: Aydınlatıcı veya açık kılıcı nitelik, görmeyi ve anlamayı mümkün kılar.
Bir işaretin insanları görür veya kavrar hale getirmesi bu çekirdeğin nedensel uzantısıdır.
Açıklama ve belirgin kılma eylemi aynı alan içinde kullanılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda aydınlık, açıklık, kendisiyle görülme ve insanları görür hale getirme yönlerini bir araya getirir. Ayrıca açıklama ve belirgin kılma anlamı aynı toplu iddiada desteklenir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem ışıkla görünür kılmayı hem de açık seçik gösterme işlevini birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Aydınlatma, açıklık ve görmeyi veya kavramayı mümkün kılma çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir işaretin anlamı belirgin kılması bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Açıklık ve gösterme işlevini korur.

error_profile.loses: Açıklayıcı delil ve insanı kavrar hale getirme yönlerini daraltır.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: aydınlık, açık kılan ve görmeyi sağlayan

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal görmeyi sağlayan açıklık veya işarettir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aydınlık, ortaya çıkma ve aynı kökün gözle görme dalı sınırı en kullanışlı ayrımları sağladı. Diğer adaylar biçim, açık oluş veya yorum alanlarında daha dolaylı kaldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ما يوصف بأنه مبصر بمعنى مضيء أو بين أو مبصر به أو جاعل للناس بصراء، والتبصرة بمعنى التبيين.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه عين الإنسان نفسها ولا العلم المجرد عن إظهار أو إضاءة ولا حجارة البصرة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: المبصرة المضيئة تبصرهم أي تجعلهم بصراء والمبصرة بالفتح الحجة (sihah)؛ مبصرة مضيئة وتبين لهم ومبصرا بها (tahdhib)؛ آياتنا مبصرة أي مضيئة للأبصار وقيل صار أهله بصراء وتبصرة أي تبصيرا وتبيانا (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kanın yerdeki yuvarlak parçası, bedendeki yolları, izi, küçük miktarı ve şiirde kan bedeli veya öç bağlamı olarak verir. Dalın kimliği kan lekesi veya kan izi alanıdır; iç kavrayış ve silah anlamları yalnızca eş adlı başka dallardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kan parçası, izi, lekesi ve buna bağlı şiirsel kan bedeli veya öç kullanımıdır; göz ve bilgi alanı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kan parçası ve izi anlamını verir; başka dallardaki eş adlı kullanımlar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Yere veya bedene düşen kan parçası, kan lekesi ya da kan izi; bağlama göre bu izden hareketle kan bedeli veya öç konusu da anılır. Çekirdek, somut kan kalıntısı ve onun izleyici işaret oluşudur.

facets.statement: Yerde veya bedende görülen kan parçası, leke ya da iz çekirdektir.
Yerde yuvarlaklaşan veya parlayan küçük kan miktarı özel olarak belirtilir.
Kan izi, yaralanmayı veya atışı gösteren bir belirti olarak kullanılabilir.
Şiirsel kullanımlarda kan bedeli, kan davası veya öç anlamı bu kan alanına bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak iddiası bu dalı somut kan izi ve kan parçası olarak kurar: yerdeki parça, bedendeki yol veya yarayı gösteren belirti. Aynı toplu iddia şiir bağlamında kan bedeli ve öç bağlantılarını da çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kan parçası, leke, yerdeki veya bedendeki kan yolu çekirdeğini kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Somut kan kalıntısı ve işaret oluşunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yere veya bedene düşmüş görünen kan parçası anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Somut kan parçası ve leke yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: İzden sonuç çıkarma ve şiirsel kan bedeli uzantısını daraltır.

error_profile.preserves: Bağlı hukukî veya şiirsel uzantıyı korur.

error_profile.loses: Somut kan parçası, leke ve iz anlamını kaybeder.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yayımlanan ayrımlar somut parça, kan hesabı ve aynı kökün silah dalıyla karışma ihtimalini kapsar. Diğer adaylar renk, yerde iz veya kanın boşa gitmesi gibi daha uzak bağlantılar verdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البصيرة من الدم: القطعة أو الطريقة أو المقدار على الأرض أو الجسد، وما اتصل بها من ثأر أو دية في الشعر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بصيرة القلب ولا الترس والدرع إلا من جهة اشتراك اللفظ أو التشبيه.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البصيرة القطعة من الدم إذا وقعت بالأرض استدارت (maqayis;jamhara)؛ بصائر الدماء طرائقها على الجسد (ayn)؛ البصيرة من الدم ما كان على الأرض وشيء من الدم يستدل به على الرمية (sihah)؛ بصيرة من دم والجدية منها على الأرض والبصيرة الدية ومقدار الدرهم من الدم (tahdhib)؛ البصيرة قطعة من الدم تلمع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı kalkan, zırh ve savaşta giyilen koruyucu donanım anlamında toplar. Bazı ifadelerde parlaklık veya şiir tanıklığı bulunsa da dalın çekirdeği koruyucu silah nesnesidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kalkan, zırh ve giyilen savaş korumasıdır; kan lekesi, iç kavrayış ve kumaş dikişi anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın koruyucu savaş nesnesi anlamını verir; başka eş adlı dallar içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Savaşta korunmak için kullanılan kalkan, zırh veya giyilen koruyucu silah donanımı. Parlaklık ya da şiirsel tanıklık, nesnenin kendisine bağlı ayrıntıdır.

facets.statement: Kalkan, zırh veya giyilen koruyucu savaş nesnesi çekirdektir.
Kaynaklar kalkan ile zırh arasında değişen adlandırmalar verir, fakat ikisi de koruyucu silah alanındadır.
Parlak kalkan niteliği nesnenin olası betimleyici yönüdür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak iddiası bu dalı koruyucu savaş gereci olarak verir: kalkan, zırh veya giyilen silah. Kalkan ile zırh arasındaki farklı adlandırma çekirdek alanı değiştirmez; hepsi koruma nesnesi çerçevesindedir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kalkan, zırh ve giyilen savaş korumasını tek başlıkta toplar.

error_profile.preserves: Koruma amacı, savaş bağlamı ve nesne türünü korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kalınlık, yan veya kenar, dış deri, iki deri parçasını dikme, ev veya elbise parçaları arasındaki şerit ve iki parçayı birleştiren yama malzemesini birlikte verir. Çekirdek, kenar-kalınlık ile parçaların birleştirilmesi alanında düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Nesnenin kalın kenarı, yanı ve iki parça arasını dikme veya birleştirme alanıdır; taş, göz ve iç bilgi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın kalın kenar ve birleştirici dikiş alanını verir; başka kalıplardan ek anlam alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kalın dış yanı, kenarı veya yüzeyi ve iki deri, kumaş ya da kap parçasını bir araya getirip dikilen ara bölüm. Dal, kalın kenar fikri ile parçaları ek yerinden birleştirme fikrini aynı maddi yüzey alanında tutar.

facets.statement: Nesnenin kalın dış yanı, kenarı, yüzeyi veya yönü çekirdeğin bir bölümüdür.
İki deri, kumaş veya kap parçasının ek yerinden dikilip birleştirilmesi çekirdeğin diğer bölümüdür.
Çadır, elbise veya su kabı parçaları arasındaki şerit ya da bölüm bu birleştirme alanının özel nesnesidir.
İki parça arasında yamanmış veya eklenmiş şey aynı alanın sonuç nesnesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kalınlık, yan, kenar ve dış yüzey anlamlarını iki parça arasını dikme ve ek yeri nesnesiyle birlikte verir. Toplu iddia, çadır, elbise, deri ve su kabı gibi maddi örnekleri aynı kenar ve birleştirme alanına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem nesnenin kalın dış yanını hem de iki parçanın dikildiği ara bölümü korur.

error_profile.preserves: Kenar, kalınlık, dış yüzey ve birleştirici dikiş çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz bir nesnenin yanı, dış yüzeyi veya kalın tarafı için kullanıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yan ve kenar yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Dikişle birleştirme ve ara parça yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri, kumaş veya kap parçalarının birleştirildiği bölüm anlatıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İki parçayı dikme, ara bölüm ve sonuç ek yerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal beden veya şeyin yanı ve yakın çevresi alanında kalır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisinde de yan ve kenar fikri bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu genel yan veya taraf adıdır; bu dal maddi kalınlık ve parçaları dikerek birleştirme yönünü de taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ayrıca nesnenin kalın kenarı ve ara parçasını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal dikiş ve onarma eylemini daha genel anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de kumaş veya deriyi dikerek birleştirme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dikiş eylemine odaklanır; bu dal dikişin oluşturduğu kenar, ara parça ve kalın yüzey alanını da içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kenar kalınlığı ve farklı maddelerdeki ara bölümü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iki kumaşın kenarlarından bitiştirilmesine daha dar bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de iki parçayı kenarlarından birleştirme alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu belirli bir birleşmiş kumaş sonucuna yakındır; bu dal daha geniş maddi kenar ve dikiş alanını kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kenar, dikiş ve ek yeri alanındaki en yakın adaylar yayımlandı. Diğer komşular kenar, örme veya çözme gibi tematik bağlar taşısa da temel sınırı daha iyi açıklamadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه غلظ الشيء وجلده أو جانبه وحرفه، وخياطة أديم إلى أديم أو ما بين شقتي البيت أو الثوب أو المزادة، والقطعة الملفقة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه حجارة البصرة الرخوة ولا حاسة البصر ولا بصيرة القلب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بصر الشيء غلظه والبصر هو أن يضم أديم إلى أديم يخاطان والبصيرة ما بين شقتي البيت (maqayis)؛ البصر غلظ الشيء نحو بصر الجبل والسماء والحائط (ayn)؛ بصر كل شيء جلده الظاهر وثوب ذو بصر إذا كان غليظا وثيجا (jamhara)؛ البصر أن يضم أديم إلى أديم والبصر بالضم الجانب والحرف من كل شيء وغلظها (sihah)؛ الباصر الملفق بين شقتين والبصيرة الشقة التي تكون على الخباء والبصر أن يضم أديم إلى أديم (tahdhib)؛ البصر الناحية والبصيرة ما بين شقتي الثوب والمزادة وبصرت الثوب والأديم إذا خطت ذلك الموضع (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı yumuşak, parlak veya beyaza çalan taşlar ve bu taşlı yer adıyla açıklar; ayrıca bu yer adına gitme kalıbı verilir. Dalın çekirdeği taş türü ve taşlı yerdir, başka yer adları veya nispetler dahil değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taş ve bu taşlı yer anlamıdır; göz, iç kavrayış, dikiş ve dış yer adları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak taş ve taşlı yer anlamını temel alır; o yere gitme kalıbı bağlı kullanım olarak ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taşlar ve böyle taşları bulunan yer. Bu yer adından hareketle oraya gitme kullanımı çekirdeğe bağlı bir yönelme kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı taşlar çekirdektir.
Bu taşların bulunduğu arazi veya yer adı aynı çekirdeğe bağlıdır.
Bu adla anılan yere varmak veya gitmek bağlı kalıplaşmış kullanımdır.
Kaynaklar yumuşaklık, parlaklık, beyazlık ve alçımsı arazi niteliklerini aynı taş alanında toplar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda yumuşak taş, parlak taş, beyaza çalan taş ve böyle taşlı arazi niteliklerini birleştirir. Aynı toplu iddia, bu taşlı yer adından türeyen oraya gitme kullanımını da bağlı bir kullanım olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taş türünün yumuşaklık, parlaklık ve beyazımsı görünüm niteliklerini kısa biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Taş maddesini, yumuşaklığı, parlaklığı ve taşlı yer uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz taşlarıyla adlandırılmış arazi veya yer için kullanıldığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Taşlı arazi veya yer uzantısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Taşın yumuşak, parlak veya beyazımsı niteliğini daraltır.

error_profile.preserves: Yer adıyla bağlantılı varma veya gitme kullanımını korur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Taş niteliği ve taşlı araziyle ilgili en yakın adaylar seçildi. Diğer yer ve renk adayları daha uzak olduğu veya özel yer adıyla karışıklık üretmediği için yayımlanmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البصرة والبصر بمعنى الحجارة الرخوة أو البراقة أو المائلة إلى البياض، والأرض المسماة بذلك، ومنه تسمية البصرة والإتيان إليها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بصرى الشام ولا الأباصر ولا السيف البصري ولا بنصر الإصبع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: البصرة الحجارة الرخوة وبصر بكسر الباء من الأصل الثاني (maqayis)؛ البصرة أرض حجارتها جص والبصرة الحجارة التي فيها بعض اللين (ayn)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة وبه سميت البصرة (jamhara)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة إلى البياض وبصر بالكسر (sihah)؛ البصر والبصرة الحجارة البراقة وأرض كأنها جبل من جص وبصر الأرض غلظها وبصر فلان تبصيرا إذا أتى البصرة (tahdhib)؛ البصرة حجارة رخوة تلمع ويقال له بصر (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Bu kök çok dallıdır: gözle görme ve iç kavrayış gibi algı temelli dalların yanında açıklık, kan izi, koruyucu savaş gereci, kalın kenar-ek yeri ve yumuşak parlak taş anlamları bulunur. Dallar eş adlı ve kısmen imgesel bağlantılar taşısa da her biri kendi madde, eylem veya kavrayış alanında sınırlandırılmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin merkezi, bir kişiye ya da şeye sevgi beslemek ve gönülden yakınlık duymaktır. Yazılı ileti ile öğüt gibi sevgi doğuran araçlar da aktarılır; ancak bunlar sevginin kendisi değil, bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sevgi, karşılıklı yakınlık ve seven kişi nitelemelerini kapsar; bir şeyin olmasını dileme anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, çıplak biçimlerdeki sevgi çekirdeğini bağlı kişi nitelemelerinden ve yazılı ileti ya da öğüt bildiren özel kullanımlardan ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye ya da şeye sevgi beslemek, ona gönülden yakınlık duymak ve bu sevginin kişiler arasında karşılıklı olabilmesidir. Seven kişiyi niteleyen biçimler ile sevgiyi doğuran yazılı ileti veya öğüt gibi araçlar bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ya da şeye sevgi beslemek ve ona gönülden yakınlık duymak.
Sevginin karşılıklı olması veya bir kişinin çok seven ve sevgi gösteren diye nitelenmesi.
Yazılı ileti, öğüt ve benzeri sevgi doğuran araçların sevgiyle bağlantılı biçimde adlandırılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sevgi, gönülden yakınlık ve seven kişi anlamlarında birleşir. Toplu aktarım ayrıca karşılıklı sevgiyi ve yazılı ileti ya da öğüt gibi sevgiyi doğuran araçlara uzanan bağlı kullanımları içerir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kişi veya şeye yönelen temel sevgi anlamını ve gönülden yakınlık bileşenini birlikte verir.

error_profile.preserves: Sevgi yönelimini ve gönülden yakınlık çekirdeğini eksiksiz korur.

contextual_glosses.text: birini ya da bir şeyi sevmek
contextual_glosses.applicability: Sevginin bir kişi veya şeye yöneldiği fiil bağlamlarında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Yönelinen kişi veya şeye karşı sevgi besleme anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki tarafın birbirini sevdiği ve sevgiyi paylaştığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sevginin iki taraf arasında karşılıklı oluşunu açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin sürekli ya da güçlü biçimde seven olarak nitelendiği kullanımlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Seven kişiye ilişkin güçlendirilmiş nitelemeyi korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir kişi ya da şeye yönelik sevgi ve gönülden yakınlık bildirir.
